terra.problem: Ahab being a king of Israel is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The line about the exit Jehoshaphat never took implies a contrast with his conduct that this passage does not establish.
Elisha being a prophet is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Papa comments on how he tells the passage when he announces that he is not going to joke.
David being a king of Israel is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Saying Edom did not just grumble implies that they did grumble, which the passage does not say.
The passage does not say whether Jehoram waited before attacking.
Sitting in an oven hoping the timer goes off is an unclear comparison and does not match the action being explained.
The passage says the troops fled, but does not specify that they fled after the attack.
Saying the rebellion never got fixed goes beyond the writer's statement that it continued to his day.
Saying Edom never came back under Judah's hand goes beyond the time covered by the verse.
The verse does not mention tribute, but continued rebellion does not establish that a yearly payment was impossible.
Mixing up a spoon and a ladle does not clearly match mixing up two kings with similar names.
The passage does not establish that Ben-hadad died shortly before these events.
Telling the baker they grabbed the wrong king uses 'wrong' about their answer.
Saying the baker's name search ended at the wrong shelf uses 'wrong' about their answer.
Elisha being a prophet is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Elisha is not mentioned in the passage, but that does not establish that he was absent from the trip.
The passage says Joram returned to Jezreel, but does not call it his home.
Calling the visit friendly adds a characterization the passage does not give.
The passage does not say that Joram needed rest or that he did not need an anointing. Anointing is also not the same as receiving a new crown.
